purpose: Replace local saves before enabling real payments, global rankings, or online PvP.

currencyRules.premium: Credit gems only from a verified payment-provider callback. Never trust client currency or reward amounts.
currencyRules.idempotency: Unique provider transaction ID, ledger entry, and database transaction are mandatory.
currencyRules.dailyReset: Server clock at 00:00 GMT+7; training-seal acquisition cap 1600/account/day.
currencyRules.offline: Server last-claim timestamp; 12-hour cap; rate derived from stored hero levels and cleared stages.

plannedEndpoints.transaction: debit + server RNG + pity + roster/material/gear + result receipt

plannedEndpoints.returns: opaque match ID + server seed + pinned normalized stats

plannedEndpoints.validation: turn owner, adjacent cells, resulting match, authoritative board and HP

plannedEndpoints.transaction: terminal server state + unique reward receipt; never accept client win flag

plannedEndpoints.ranking: verified highest floor, then fewer turns, then earliest achievement

plannedEndpoints.status: coming-soon; no payment handling exists yet

securityBoundary: The browser implementation is a playable local prototype. It cannot provide authoritative anti-cheat, monetary integrity, admin access control, or cross-device ranking.
